title: Naturally Crispy Polish Potato Bake
description: A briny and crispy Polish dish featuring lemon zest, perfect for crowds, made in a mason jar with a salt bake method, raw friendly ingredients. This recipe is a unique twist on traditional Polish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, lemon zest, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix together the salt and 1/4 cup of water to create a salt paste.
Apply the salt paste to the inside of a mason jar, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Add a layer of potatoes to the mason jar, followed by a sprinkle of chopped parsley and a sprinkle of grated cheddar cheese if using.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the mason jar from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
